Lissandra.summary: Her W or R easily stops your engage and cancels your ult, and she is very hard to kill one-on-one. Focus on farming and roaming, and in teamfights wait until she has used her CC before diving in.

Azir.summary: His soldiers poke and zone you off farm and engages, and his ult can deny your all-in and cancel your ult. Be patient, avoid free poke, and look for windows when his E or R is on cooldown; roaming is often better than forcing a lane kill.

Galio.summary: He resists magic damage well and has lots of CC to stop your engage and ult. An AD or on-hit Katarina build is a good option. Do not ult while his W is available, and punish him after he spends his abilities.
